published.name: swap_base
published.description: Universal token swap on Base (chain 8453). Buy or sell any ERC-20, best-execution routing via LI.FI (Sushiswap/Uniswap/etc). On-chain settlement: you provide the input token via ACP fund-transfer; the output is sent to your recipient address. Slippage configurable (default 3%, max 50%). Full refund of your input if the swap fails or the SLA expires. IMPORTANT: pass the token CONTRACT ADDRESS in lowercase (0x...), never the ticker (symbols are ambiguous/spoofable and can route into the wrong token). Required: token_in (address), token_out (address), amount_in (human units), recipient (0x address). Optional: slippage (percent). Network fixed = Base only.

published.name: swap_arbitrum
published.description: Universal token swap on Arbitrum (42161). Buy/sell any ERC-20, best-execution via LI.FI. Input via ACP fund-transfer; output to your recipient. Default slippage 3% (max 50%). Full refund if the swap fails or SLA expires. IMPORTANT: pass the token CONTRACT ADDRESS in lowercase (0x...), not the ticker (symbols are ambiguous/spoofable). Required: token_in(address), token_out(address), amount_in(human units), recipient(0x). Network = Arbitrum only.

published.name: bridge_base_arbitrum

Full refund on failure/SLA. IMPORTANT: token_in = lowercase 0x contract ON BASE; token_out = lowercase 0x contract ON ARBITRUM. Required: token_in, token_out, amount_in(human units), recipient(0x on Arbitrum).
